messages:
sophia: Quick design review — updated composer stream UI mock. Primary changes: move live token counter to left, consolidate stop/regenerate affordance, and add prompt-library quick-insert. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.ai/s/compose-stream-v3.png

alex: Nice. Question — can the token counter be collapsed by default? Feels noisy on short responses.

maria: Agree on collapse. Also a11y: token pill contrast is pretty low on dark theme, cc @aria (a11y).

aria (a11y): Checked contrast — ~2.8:1 for medium text against current bg. Need >=4.5:1. Recommend either lighter token bg (#ECEFF1) or 1px stroke + keep text bold. Also ensure stop button has aria-pressed state + visible focus ring.

jamal: UX nit: combining stop + regenerate into one control might confuse users. Suggest primary = Stop while streaming, and surface Regenerate in overflow or as secondary after completion.

sophia: My thought: while streaming the button should read 'Stop' (primary). After stream ends, swap to 'Regenerate' or show small '••' menu with Regenerate. Keeps intent clear.

alex: Token counter update frequency — avoid jitter. Should sample or debounce updates (e.g., every 200-300ms) instead of updating per token.

maria: Runtime already sends token_count in stream events. Client-side debounce is fine: e.g., setInterval 250ms to refresh visible count.

ui-bot: deploy-preview available: https://staging.redwood.ai/ui/streams/compose-123 — visual diff attached in thread.

jamal: On the preview: token chip jumps width as numbers change — causes layout shift. Fix by giving chip fixed/min width based on max expected label (use '9999' width). CSS sample:
```css
.token-chip { min-width: 48px; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
```

sophia: Good catch — tabular-nums will help. Also update microcopy: change 'Stop / Retry' to 'Stop • Regenerate' — 'retry' feels like an error state.

aria (a11y): Keyboard flow: ensure Stop and Regenerate reachable with single Tab. Use aria-label that includes state: e.g., 'Stop stream, 12 tokens generated' or 'Regenerate last response'. Use aria-live polite for token count updates so screen readers aren't spammed.

maria: Prompt library quick-insert: when inserting a snippet we should focus the editor and place cursor at end, but avoid stealing focus from screen reader context. Use aria-live polite and only move focus for sighted keyboard users.

alex: Analytics: track compose.stop_clicked and compose.regen_clicked with token_count and prompt_template_id. Also track collapsed_token_counter_toggled.

sophia: I'll update the mocks and create a short a11y checklist and implementation notes: collapse default, debounce token updates, fixed-width chip, aria labels, and button state transitions. Thanks all :sparkles:

maria: LGTM :thumbsup:
